text:
olivia: Quick check — we have a docs PR that needs to land before tomorrow's release (18:00 PT). PR updates migration guide + SDK snippet and adds versioned path under /docs/v1.2/. Is the docs preview stable?

ci-bot: [automated] docs preview build started: https://ci.internal/reports/12345

ci-bot: build failed: broken link detected in migration-guide.md -> /models/open-api.md (404)

kevin: I can fix that. Which exact reference?

olivia: It's in the migration guide, section "Model specs" — the link should be /models/openapi.md (no dash). Also the SDK snippet references `client.models.get_open_api()` which we changed to `client.models.get_schema()` in v1.2.

ashwin: Heads up — the new tokenizer split is behind ff/new-split-tokenizer. If the docs instruct users to flip it, we need a note or gated wording until the flag is on for the release.

tara: Agreed. We should avoid telling users to enable flags that aren't enabled for GA. Either mark as "experimental (flag)" or keep steps in an appendix.

kevin: I'll push two commits: 1) fix link, 2) update SDK snippet to `client.models.get_schema()` and add a short callout: "This behavior is controlled by ff/new-split-tokenizer". Pushing now (sha: abc1234).

ci-bot: [automated] running docs preview again for commit abc1234...

ci-bot: build passed — preview: https://preview.docs.internal/r/1768009999

docs-bot: Preview deployed to staging at https://preview.docs.internal/r/1768009999 — diff: +8 −3 (files changed: migration-guide.md, sdk-snippets.md)

ashwin: skimmed the preview — SDK snippet code looks good. Suggest making the flag callout inline and add a short example showing how to check the flag state in Console.

kevin: added inline callout and small Console screenshot link. New commit sha: def5678.

tara: I'm available to merge but want approvals. @ashwin @olivia can you review final? I can do the merge at 16:30 PT to give us buffer before cutoff (17:00 PT).

ashwin: Reviewing now, LGTM except one tiny wording nit in the migration intro (changed).

olivia: Approved — thanks for handling the flag wording.

kevin: All set from my side. I'll re-run a quick local link check and then queue for merge.

tara: Will merge at 16:30 PT assuming CI still green and no last-minute blockers. If anything fails, we'll hold until next slot.

olivia: Thank you — please add a one-line note in the release notes about the docs change and the flag gating.

kevin: done. release-notes entry added.

docs-bot: [info] merged PR #4892 by tara at 1768013400 — deployed to stable docs within next deploy window.

olivia: Awesome — closing the loop. :tada:
